items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: And Miss Moore asked me how would I like to travel, you know. So I said, well, 'yes, ma'am, sure I would,'

ctx.x: Yeah, you see, that was a way of life, you see. It was actually a reality because these bootleggers, the law was after them, you see, what they call the revenooers or something, you see. And Mr. Moore, Chinch Moore, you see, they based their routines on these realities of life, ways of
life, you see. And that's what made it so comical, because -- pardon me, please.
